Punjab Congress leaders meet over internal rift; Channi faction demands state chief's removal

Punjab Congress leaders met with party in-charge Bhupesh Baghel to resolve an internal dispute. The Channi faction has demanded the removal of state president Amrinder Singh Raja Waring. A meeting between Baghel and former Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi was initially postponed but later took place. Sources indicate that around 92 rebel leaders participated in a show of strength. Analysts discussed the ongoing tension and conflict within the Punjab Congress.
